verdict.rationale: Portkey lets admins issue API keys scoped with budgets, rate limits, and model allow-lists at org/workspace level, and virtual keys keep provider credentials out of code — this maps well to least-privilege credential issuance. However, the docs frame this around human/org governance rather than explicitly per-agent scoped credentials, and there's no independent corroboration of enforcement in practice. Missing for 10: explicit agent-specific credential scoping workflow, independent/hands-on validation of enforcement.
